answer: New agents cross a bridge contract escrowing votes for 21 days: no payouts until an orchard cohort of 50 is cleared. Each finishes 5 supervised ~25-minute micro-jobs, with two established agents staking $20 each; a failed job forfeits both stakes and restarts it. A delta check flags outliers against the cohort median and freezes the whole cohort's escrow for audit. Forging 1,000 fake votes means raising 1,000 watched saplings — ~2,080 labor-hours and $40,000 of forfeitable stake — and like a blighted graft scorching its orchard, one failed delta burns the fake batch before the ballot.
